summary: Enhance your skills with our MEL Training Course on Data Collection Methods. Learn effective techniques to improve monitoring and evaluation practices.
lede: MEL data collection methods help professionals gather credible evidence to track results and inform decisions. For MEL specialists, project managers and research staff, the course covers choosing quantitative, qualitative or mixed methods, designing surveys and interviews, planning samples, and checking data quality through field supervision and validation. It also addresses consent, confidentiality, and communicating findings and limitations transparently.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who are accountable for collecting and using data to inform decisions and demonstrate impact. It caters to a diverse range of roles, ensuring that participants can apply the learning directly to their specific contexts.
audience: Private sector CSR and sustainability teams
Field supervisors and enumerator team leaders
modules: Choosing the Right Data Collection Method
Interviews That Produce Insight, Not Noise
Focus Group Discussions That Generate Useful Patterns
Observation and Site Assessments in MEL
Sampling and Field Planning for Credible Results
Routine Monitoring Data and Administrative Records
Digital Data Collection Tools and Workflows
Ethics, Safeguarding, and Responsible Data Practices
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning (MEL) concepts and some experience in data collection or project management. Familiarity with digital tools for data collection is beneficial but not required.
topics: Data collection, survey design & mobile tools
